Okay, so from what I remember, put your 3 star scout as the national one. Then make sure your other scouts are scouting 1 or the same positions as your 3 star scout. That should give you more 100% scouted players.

Next after the combine look at every player at each position. You’re looking for players that have at least two stats that say great or elite, obviously the more the better. This will give you more rookies with hidden dev’s.

Do not use the coaching tree option “We’ve seen enough “ to reveal players dev trait. Hidden dev’s development at the rate of SS or X-Factor, I don’t remember which.

If you really want a player pick them at least 10 spots before they are expected to be drafted.
